description: An interface defining the base contract for all logic rules within the OpenMRS core project, including method signatures for evaluation, parameter retrieval, dependencies, TTL, and default data type.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: An interface representing a logic rule in the system, specifying evaluation and metadata methods.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule for a specific patient within a given context and parameters, returning a Result object.

methods.name: getParameterList
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters that the rule accepts.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Provides an array of rule tokens or data sources that this rule depends upon.

methods.name: getTTL
methods.description: Returns the time-to-live (in seconds) indicating how long the rule's results are valid.

methods.name: getDefaultDatatype
methods.description: Returns the default data type of the result produced by the rule.
